downstream.name: HumanPlayer_LoadParameters
remaining_blockers: Qvm_Execute (0x004B85B0) now exists but cannot link until the eleven undefined symbols it consumes are resolved: its eight execution callees and the three shared state words (0x00A965A0/0x00A965A8/0x00A96598), which are not callees and need external linkage rather than transcription.
Retail calls Qvm_Load at 0x004137A8, Qvm_Execute at 0x004137B5 and Qvm_Cleanup at 0x004137BA. Qvm_Load and Qvm_Cleanup are ported; Qvm_Execute is the only new source dependency of this function.

Separately from these two natives, the candidate's Qvm_Load does not resolve a precompiled program: the force-precompiled/debug-compile setters (0x0048F330/0x0048F1C0) are never called, g_5c8bec/g_5c8bf0 stay 0, and the injectable 0x004BD220 resolver (g_sys_resolve_symbol_28) defaults to null. Retail startup sets both flags to 1 (0x0040100A, 0x0048F627) and resolves humanplayer.qvm into qvm+0x8C. Without that, Qvm_Load takes its resource path for the .qsc name and returns null, and the loader spins in its failure path.

downstream.name: DefineHumanPlayerGeneral
remaining_blockers: The body must be rewritten to fetch its arguments through Qvm_GetFloatArg (0x004B8A50) at the retail call sites 0x41007D, 0x41008B, 0x4100A5, 0x4100BF, 0x4100D9, 0x4100ED, 0x410101, 0x41011C, 0x410132, 0x41014A and 0x410169, instead of taking a flat float array.
Qvm_GetFloatArg now exists but cannot link until 0x004BD010 and 0x004B9660 are transcribed.

The argument frame it reads (+0x04 flag, +0x08 value table) is produced by the native-call path of the interpreter (Qvm_ExecuteInstructions 0x004BCFD0); that handler table is still empty in the candidate (Qvm_SetOpcodeHandler is only transmitted), so no candidate code builds the frame.
The retail body's x87 scaling and the index-6 integer conversion are outside these two natives and remain for the DefineHumanPlayerGeneral owner.

how_to_unblock: Move g_a965a0, g_a965a8 and g_a96598 out of the anonymous namespace in qvm_native_loader.cpp (or add accessors) so this unit shares the retail words instead of duplicating them.
Transcribe the eight 0x004B85B0 callees and add the file to the igi target source list; then link the executable and re-run the build gate.
Transcribe 0x004BD010 and 0x004B9660 before DefineHumanPlayerGeneral can be rewritten against Qvm_GetFloatArg.
Port the 0x004BD220 program installer and the startup calls to 0x0048F330(1)/0x0048F1C0(1) so Qvm_Load produces the branch-A object the retail executes.
limitations: This audit is static: it lists unresolved symbols in the compiled object and the known record states; it is not a runtime test and does not claim any downstream function is verified.

The object also has an undefined reference to Qvm_ReportError; it is already implemented in qvm_native_loader.cpp, so it is not a blocker and links as soon as that unit is in the igi target. The other fourteen undefined symbols above are the blockers.

The two QVM state words 0x00A965A4 and 0x00A96598 have writers (BreakScript 0x004B8C10, Sys_ExecuteBytecode_23 0x004B8970) that are not ported, so even after linking the branches exist but are never armed by candidate code.
